capability: A check after every stage, not only at the end
title: A gate after every step.

hook.picture: Close on the whale at the end of a long line with four stations. It rings the last station: fine. A pod reading the result turns raw sienna ✕.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We checked the final answer. The mistake happened at step two.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: ML engineer after a bad retrieval answer

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the same four-station line, three runs. A smudge enters at station two and rides to the end (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: One check at the end comes too late.

stakes.body: The bad answer ships, and debugging starts at the wrong end of the line.

solution_hint: Check after every step, not just the end.

metaphor.body: A gate stands after every station on the line, and each station hands on only work that has passed its gate. The rules sit as pins that never move. Raw sienna alarm.

steps.picture: A gate drops after each of the four stations.
A clean run passes all four gates, each glowing as it passes. Each station's output wears a small tick.
steps.words: Each step hands on checked work.

steps.picture: Push-in: a smudge enters at station two. Gate two shuts in raw sienna right there, and the line stops before station three.
Pull back to the whole line, gate after gate, labelled.
steps.words: A check on each stage of the pipeline.

real_case.claim: VERA makes verification a first-class stage that can be inserted at any point of an AI pipeline (Pipeline[A,B] to Pipeline[A, Verified[B]]), under a constitution of 9 immutable articles.

honest_limit.picture: A run with the right shape but an out-of-date fact passes all four gates. Every station gives it a tick. No gate asks how old the fact is.
honest_limit.words: Each check passed. The fact was old.

not_this.body: Checked at every step is not proved.

ending_pattern.body: Seen from the end where act 1 began, the line is a row of lit gates. The bad step is held at gate two, far from the reader.
ending_pattern.callback: Act 1's lone ring at the end becomes four lit gates. The smudge stops at station two.

end_belief.body: Put a check after every step.

beats.sound: A single bell, muffled and late

beats.picture: A pod reads the result and turns raw sienna ✕.
The whale swims back up the line. At station two, a small smudge entered and rode all the way down.
beats.words: The error came in way earlier.

score_self.reason: The FELT reveal (the smudge came in at step two) is strong for engineers. The case shows a design, not a run, so it is labelled Illustration. The nine-pin row adds a fourth idea that may compete with the gates.
